title: Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration: Bootstrapping Generative Auto-bidding from Narrow Support
title_zh: 迭代稀缺性引导探索（ISGE）：从狭窄数据支持域自举生成式自动出价
abstract_en: Auto-bidding is a core algorithmic component in online advertising auctions. In practical cold-start settings, iterative training is commonly used to compensate for low-quality, narrowly supported historical data. Unfortunately, in iterative training, representative diffusion-based AI-Generated Bidding (AIGB) methods fail to sustain extrapolation beyond the narrow data support and stagnate at a suboptimal level. In this paper, we theoretically attribute this stagnation to Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) collapse: the weak radial return signal is overwhelmed by a curvature-induced penalty. To break this stagnation, we propose \textbf{Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration (ISGE)}, which introduces a guidance handoff: as the return signal collapses, scarcity subsequently takes over as an exploratory signal to elevate the SNR above a critical threshold. Specifically, ISGE iteratively alternates between a \emph{Judger} that assigns scarcity scores to trajectories and an \emph{Explorer} that performs guided generation of high-scarcity and high-return trajectories, thereby bootstrapping from the narrow support with such self-generated trajectories. Extensive experiments on the industrial AuctionNet benchmark demonstrate that ISGE, starting from cold-start datasets, effectively surpasses the performance of the Full-Dataset baseline within three iterations. Code is available at https://github.com/alimama-tech/ISGE
abstract_zh: 自动出价是在线广告竞价的核心算法组件。冷启动时，历史数据往往质量较低、覆盖范围有限，因此实践中常用迭代训练弥补数据不足。然而，具有代表性的扩散式 AI-Generated Bidding（AIGB）方法难以持续探索历史数据支持域之外的策略，最终停滞在次优水平。论文从理论上将这一现象归因于信噪比（SNR）坍塌：微弱的径向回报信号被曲率引入的惩罚项压制。为打破停滞，作者提出 Iterative Scarcity-Guided Exploration（ISGE）：当回报信号减弱时，由稀缺性接替引导探索，使 SNR 回到临界阈值以上。ISGE 交替运行 Judger 和 Explorer，前者为轨迹评估稀缺性，后者在引导下生成兼具高稀缺性和高回报的轨迹，再将这些轨迹用于后续训练。在工业基准 AuctionNet 上，ISGE 从冷启动数据出发，在三轮迭代内超越了使用完整数据的 Full-Dataset 基线。
key_points_zh: 冷启动瓶颈：扩散式 AIGB 即使经过多轮训练，也难以持续探索历史数据覆盖范围之外的出价策略。
理论解释：曲率引入的惩罚项压过微弱的径向回报信号，导致信噪比坍塌、性能停滞。
核心方法：回报信号减弱时，由稀缺性接替引导；Judger 为轨迹打分，Explorer 生成高稀缺性、高回报的轨迹，用于下一轮训练。
实验结果：在 AuctionNet 上，ISGE 仅从冷启动数据出发，就在三轮迭代内超越 Full-Dataset 基线。
